This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Your Role at Baxter

As a Critical Account Lead, you will serve as the single point of accountability for Baxter's most complex customer escalations within the Care Communications Solutions business. This newly created role was designed to improve the customer experience when issues span multiple products, teams, or technologies.

You'll partner closely with Technical Support, Product Management, R&D, Customer Success, Sales, and leadership teams to coordinate resolution efforts and ensure customers have a clear path forward. This is an opportunity to help build a new function, influence how critical customer situations are managed, and play a direct role in strengthening Baxter's relationships with healthcare customers.

What You'll Do

• Own critical customer escalations from intake through customer stabilization, serving as the single point of accountability throughout the lifecycle.
• Triage incoming escalations, assess severity levels, and determine appropriate engagement and response plans.
• Lead cross-functional resolution teams across Technical Support, Product Management, R&D, Customer Success, Services, and Sales.
• Coordinate resolution activities for complex customer issues, including incidents that span multiple products, technologies, business units, and support organizations.
• Deliver executive-level status updates and escalation communications to internal stakeholders and customer leadership.
• Maintain escalation records, action plans, and status reporting within established systems and processes.
• Conduct post-incident reviews, document root causes, and identify opportunities to improve products, processes, and customer outcomes.
• Support the development of escalation criteria, critical account pathways, performance metrics, and scalable operational processes for the Critical Account Lead program.

What You'll Bring

• Bachelor's degree in Healthcare, Information Technology, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
• 8+ years of experience in technical support, escalation management, technical account management, customer success, program management, or related customer-facing technical roles.
• Experience managing high-severity customer issues that require coordination across multiple teams, products, or business functions.
• Knowledge of healthcare technology environments, hospital IT operations, or medical device technologies.
• Experience working with networking technologies and HL7 integrations.
• Proficiency with program and case management tools such as ServiceNow, Salesforce, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms.

Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER, REINFORCEMENT LEARNING

- SpaceXAI is building the future of coding. We train frontier coding agents and scale RL on real user data to make them increasingly effective.

About the role

- As a Software Engineer on the RL Data team at SpaceXAI, you'll create the tasks, rewards, and environments that train our coding agents. The team owns the data that goes into training: what the model is asked to do, how we score it, and the setups it learns in.

What you’ll do

- Designing a task set that teaches a specific agent capability, then iterating on it from traces and evals until the model actually gets better.

- Reading a pile of agent traces, finding a failure mode or a surprising behavior, and building a system that surfaces more of the same.

- Turning a one-off recipe into something other teams can reuse: better rewards, cleaner environments, tighter data quality.

- Partnering with research on whether a dataset is actually teaching the thing we think it is.

You may be a fit if

- You write careful, fast code and have strong software engineering fundamentals.

- You like setting tasks: breaking a fuzzy capability into something concrete you can measure.

- You have an infra, data, or distributed systems background. RL experience is a plus, not a requirement.

- You enjoy looking at messy real-world agent behavior and turning it into a dataset or a tool.

About the Team

DoorDash Digital Ordering is DoorDash’s leading SaaS business unit, offering a suite of products across online ordering, branded websites and mobile apps, loyalty solutions, and more that enable restaurants to reach customers and grow their revenue through their own first-party channels.

The business is one of the fastest-growing segments within DoorDash, and yet is only scratching the surface of a generational opportunity to better serve hundreds of thousands of merchants across the Americas to help them grow their business and improve working lives in one of the country’s biggest industry sectors.

Strategy & Operations sits at the center of that opportunity. The team partners with Product to set the strategy and vision for every offering in the suite, across our SMB and enterprise merchants. We decide what to build, where to invest, and how to bring it to market, and we learn by putting products in front of merchants and running the experiments that show us what moves their business.

As part of this team, the Associate Manager will take end-to-end ownership of a set of products and lead the cross-functional effort to grow them. Your work will be instrumental to helping transition DoorDash from a consumer marketplace to an industry-leading B2B SaaS company.

About the Role

As an Associate Manager on the Digital Ordering Strategy & Operations team, you will own a set of products within our first-party suite from end to end. You will set the strategy and priorities for those products in partnership with Product, be accountable for their growth, and lead the Product, Engineering, Analytics, Implementation, Sales, and Marketing partners who bring them to market. This role is ideal for a strategic operator who can move fast and wear many hats, equal parts analyst, builder, operator, and cross-functional leader.

You will own zero-to-one experiments alongside products already operating at scale, help shape the roadmap with Product, and work directly with merchants and frontline teams to identify the gaps worth solving. Scope on this team grows with demonstrated ownership, and the people who do well here identify problems independently and come back with a plan to solve them.

Scope for this role can vary between Foundation Products: the products that are table stakes for every restaurant we serve and that drive the core of our revenue today, and Growth & Insights: the next generation of products and the experimentation engine behind them.

We’re especially excited about candidates who’ve worked in fast-moving, founder-led, or resource-constrained environments, those who see lack of structure as an opportunity to build.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

• Own the product line: Take end-to-end ownership of your products. Set the strategy, define the goals and KPIs that measure success, and prioritize where to invest. You will build the business case, the financial model, and the operating plan, then carry them through launch and into growth.
• Lead cross-functionally: Bring Product, Engineering, Analytics, Implementation, Sales, Marketing, and Support behind a plan and hold partners accountable to it without formal authority. You will be the connective tissue that keeps a launch on schedule and the feedback loop that informs what gets built next.
• Analyze: Pair complex data analysis with qualitative insight from merchants and frontline teams to guide strategic decisions. You will build your own models and translate what you find into action that improves both the merchant experience and internal execution.
• Experiment: Design and launch zero-to-one tests, pilot AI-powered tools, build demos or prototype agents, and configure internal tooling that improves speed, accuracy, or effectiveness. You will move quickly to retire what does not work and scale what does.
• Represent the merchant: Act as the voice of the merchant and the field, leading discovery interviews and synthesizing feedback from Sales, Implementation, Support, and merchants themselves to help influence product roadmaps and go-to-market priorities. You will ensure our products resonate with restaurants and scale with repeatable excellence.
• Scale learnings: Codify what works. Build the repeatable frameworks, processes, and enablement that raise the bar across the org, and define best practices for launching new products in a way that’s scalable and measurable.

The best candidates will:

• Think like a founder, identifying the problems nobody flagged, building the case for solving them, and driving them to resolution with limited structure or direction
• Bring strong analytical horsepower and intellectual curiosity, comfortable diving into complex data and extracting insights that drive real-world decisions
• Thrive in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments, moving with urgency, defaulting to action, taking ownership end to end, and knowing when to bend process to get things done
• Lead cross-functional teams through influence, building trust with Product, Engineering, Sales, Account Management, and Marketing partners and holding them to their commitments
• Carry executive presence, comfortable presenting to senior leaders, defending a recommendation with data, and adapting the message to the audience
• Have experience working closely with Sales or frontline teams, and know how to turn insights from those teams into action
• Demonstrate comfort with AI, automation, or internal tooling to drive process efficiency, enable scale, or prototype solutions

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Own products from end to end and be accountable for their growth
• Imagine, develop, and execute on workstreams from start to completion with little oversight
• Oscillate easily from strategic considerations to tactical execution
• Build deep and meaningful relationships with merchants, laser focused on helping them thrive
• Have the opportunity to truly make a scalable, measurable impact on the restaurant industry in the US and abroad
• Operate comfortably in ambiguous environments while maintaining a strong bias for action
• Grow your scope as you demonstrate ownership and impact
• Communicate precisely dependent on audience and level of detail necessary to share
• Represent the DoorDash brand with humility and a customer-first mindset

We’re excited about you because you…

• 4-7 years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, product, or founder-type roles
• Have taken a product or concept from inception through launch and into growth, leading cross-functional partners without a fully defined brief
• Demonstrate the judgment to set a product’s direction and prioritize the gaps that matter most to the business
• Can devise and execute a strategy to achieve business outcomes
• Bring a strong analytical background, with the ability to synthesize large data sets into meaningful insights (proficiency in SQL preferred)
• Lead cross-functionally and influence without authority across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, and Marketing

• Bring a founder mindset, identifying problems independently and driving them to resolution
• Bachelor's degree required

Bonus if you have experience with:

• Building and executing go-to-market motions
• Working in a high-growth environment
• Client or account management
• Building financial or sales forecasting models
• Restaurant, SaaS, or marketplace businesses

• Are the first in your family to attend college

About us

At NATIONAL, we are driven by purpose, creativity, and connection. For 50 years, our teams across Canada have been delivering strategic communications expertise that helps organizations shape conversations that matter.

NATIONAL is seeking a senior communications leader for Newfoundland and Labrador. While this opportunity is currently posted at the Director level, we welcome interest from experienced communications professionals and seasoned executives, with level, scope, and title to be considered based on experience, capability, and market presence.

This is a rare opportunity for someone who knows the province, understands how decisions are made, and can move confidently between public affairs, government relations, corporate communications, and marketing conversations.

Our Newfoundland and Labrador presence is an important part of our Atlantic and national network. We work with clients across sectors, regions, and issues, helping them navigate complex environments, build trust, and communicate with clarity. With a strong local and regional foundation and access to the full strength of NATIONAL’s offices across Canada, this role offers the opportunity to help shape what comes next in one of the country’s most distinctive and strategically important markets.

The role

This is a hands-on, senior market-building opportunity for someone who wants to be both strategic and practical, visible and grounded, independent and deeply connected to a national team. We are looking for an entrepreneurial leader who can help grow NATIONAL’s presence in Newfoundland and Labrador while contributing to client work across Atlantic Canada and the broader NATIONAL network. Whether you’re currently living in the region, or looking to return home, the ideal candidate is deeply connected to the province. They understand the local business, political, and community landscape, and they bring the judgment, presence, and credibility to advise executives, engage stakeholders, and represent NATIONAL in the market.

Our office is located within the Board of Trade in St. John’s, offering a strong connection to the local business community and an energizing space for client work, collaboration, and growth.

What you will do

As a key member of the Atlantic and Canadian Advisory and Public Affairs practice team, you will provide senior counsel to clients navigating complex communications, public affairs, and reputational challenges. Our roster of clients are closely connected to the biggest opportunities and challenges NL is facing. You will bring a strong understanding of government, business, community, and media environments in Newfoundland and Labrador, with particular interest in sectors such as energy, defense, economic development, healthcare and other areas shaping the future of the province. Ideally, your experience and skillset can contribute to client needs outside of NL and outside of Atlantic Canada.

You will help lead and grow client relationships, identify new opportunities, and connect clients with the right expertise from across NATIONAL. You will be expected to work independently, think strategically, and manage mandates with confidence, while also knowing when and how to bring in colleagues from other offices and practice areas.

You will represent NATIONAL in the Newfoundland and Labrador market, helping to strengthen our visibility, relationships, and reputation. You will be comfortable in a boardroom, at a community event, in a government relations discussion, or in a marketing strategy conversation. You do not need to be a specialist in every discipline, but you should be an integrated thinker who understands how public affairs, communications, marketing, stakeholder engagement, and reputation intersect. In this role, you will be part of the broader.

What you bring

You are someone excited about local and regional connectivity and are a trusted advisor with strong judgment, sound instincts, and the ability to build relationships across sectors. You are self-motivated and credible with executives, comfortable with elected officials and senior public servants, and able to speak naturally with people from a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives.

You likely bring:

• Senior experience in public affairs, government relations, strategic communications, crisis communications, public relations, or a related professional services environment
• Strong knowledge of Newfoundland and Labrador’s political, business, community, and media landscape
• Experience or strong familiarity with sectors such as energy, defense, infrastructure, natural resources, economic development, or other regulated or high-profile industries
• The ability to lead client relationships, provide wise counsel, and manage complex mandates with limited day-to-day oversight
• A practical understanding of marketing and integrated communications, with the ability to contribute meaningfully to broader brand, reputation, and campaign conversations
• Strong writing, presentation, facilitation, and relationship-building skills
• An entrepreneurial mindset and interest in helping grow NATIONAL’s presence in Newfoundland and Labrador
• The ability to collaborate across offices, especially with Atlantic Canada, Ottawa, and other teams across the NATIONAL network
• A degree or equivalent experience in communications, public relations, political science, business, public policy, journalism, marketing, or a related field

How you work

You are strategic, but not removed from the work. You can see the larger picture, identify what matters, and turn advice into action. You are calm under pressure, clear in your counsel, and comfortable working in situations where the path forward is not always obvious. You have good judgement.

You build trust easily. You are good in a room, thoughtful in your approach, and able to move between senior executives, community leaders, public officials, colleagues, and clients with confidence and respect. You are a good writer and easily adjust to different mediums and audiences. You are collaborative, but highly self-sufficient. You can build something without needing a large local team around you, and you know how to draw on the strength of a national network when clients would benefit from additional expertise.

You are values-driven, discreet, adaptable, and committed to excellent client service.

What we offer

• The opportunity to help shape NATIONAL’s value as a consultancy in Newfoundland and Labrador
• A senior, market-facing role with room to grow based on experience, capability, and ambition
• A connected national platform with strong Atlantic Canadian collaboration
• Exposure to meaningful client work across public affairs, government relations, corporate communications, marketing, and reputation
• A dynamic, entrepreneurial environment with the support of one of Canada’s most respected communications consultancies
• Competitive compensation, commensurate with level and experience
• Hybrid flexibility with an expectation of meaningful presence in the St. John’s market
• A commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all that we do

How to apply

Qualified candidates are invited to apply by submitting a resume and a brief cover letter outlining their interest in the role, connection to Newfoundland and Labrador, and relevant experience.

NATIONAL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Should you require accommodation during the selection process, please inform us.

Please note that only candidates selected for further consideration will be contacted. As part of our recruitment process, we use artificial intelligence tools to assist with the screening, assessment, and selection of applicants for this role. Thank you for considering a career with NATIONAL.

NATIONAL Public Relations provides creative communications solutions that move people in thought and actions. We bring together a team of 300 seasoned professionals, who are committed to helping organizations of all sizes and in all sectors understand their challenges and opportunities and solve the issues they are facing. For 47 years, NATIONAL has been at the center of issues and industries that matter, leading change for today and tomorrow.

NATIONAL is Canada’s leading public relations firm, with offices in Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal, Quebec City, Saint John, Halifax and St. John’s. Its network includes Time & Space, a leader in media strategy, data analysis, planning and execution.

NATIONAL Public Relations is an AVENIR GLOBAL company, the largest Canadian-owned global communications firm, ranked among the 25 largest in the world with offices in 23 locations across Canada, the U.S., Europe and the Middle East. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities

- Data center electrical designs and collaboration with other disciplines to create a construction document set.
- Participating in site selection reviews and site planning activities
- Critical Data Center equipment design including Generators, Uninterruptible Power Supplies, MV Switchgear, LV Switchgear, MV:LV Transformers, Earthing. Life Safety and Fire Detection systems

- Being a leader within the global group as well as within internal and external teams that support Amazon’s data centers.
- Having fun and offering creative, out of the box solutions.

A day in the life
As an Electrical Engineer on our team, you'll focus on designing robust electrical distribution systems that keep our data centers running at world-class uptime. Your day might include developing design specifications, reviewing and marking up technical drawings, collaborating with cross-functional teams on equipment qualifications, conducting site inspections, responding to design inquiries, and presenting your work to stakeholders. You'll move fluidly between desk-based design work and on-site activities, ensuring designs translate seamlessly from concept to construction. You'll also have opportunities to explore new technologies and construction methods that could improve how we build and operate our facilities.

About the team
The team consists of Electrical Engineers with Design Engineering backgrounds (typically having worked as Consulting Engineers with wide ranging experience), many ex-electricians with a practical knowledge of the systems they are designing.

About AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior / Staff Behavioral Engineer to make safe behavior the path of least resistance at Suno. Instead of only catching abuse after it happens, you'll work upstream. You'll study how bad actors exploit our product and where well-intentioned employees fall into risky shortcuts. Then you'll redesign the flows, defaults, friction points, and incentives underneath so that harmful behavior is structurally harder to carry out. Working at the intersection of behavioral science, product design, and security and trust & safety, you'll partner closely with Product and Engineering to build risk-reducing changes directly into their roadmaps. This work will help lay the foundation for Suno's security programs and strengthen our overall risk posture across security, trust & safety, fraud, and privacy.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Investigate how abuse and risk actually happen on our platform and inside the company. That includes reading logs, interviewing support and ops teams, and reconstructing user and employee journeys to find the easy paths to harm.

- Design concrete changes to signup flows, permission defaults, rate limits, approval steps, and verification gates, working alongside PMs and designers.

- Get your recommendations onto other teams' roadmaps by making the case in planning meetings, writing proposals, and negotiating trade-offs, all without owning the roadmap yourself.

- Measure changes in real behavior, not just detection rates. You'll define success metrics before a change ships and run before/after comparisons to prove impact.

- Lead cross-functional root-cause reviews after incidents and near-misses by asking what about the design made risky behavior the easy option, then turning the answers into concrete backlog items.

- Stay ahead of new attack patterns by tracking industry incidents and behavioral science research. You'll design targeted awareness and training only where it's the best lever, and make sure people actually find it useful.

- Help make safe, trustworthy experiences part of how Suno builds every product, in service of making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

MUST-HAVES

- 6+ years of experience in trust & safety, security, fraud, anti-abuse, or risk-focused product work, with the technical fluency to dig into logs and data yourself and to work credibly with engineers on implementation.

- A track record of reducing risky behavior through product and process design (flows, defaults, friction, incentives), with measurable before/after results.

- Strong influence skills, including a history of getting changes prioritized on roadmaps you didn't own by building trust with Product, Engineering, and Design partners.

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Formal background in behavioral science, behavioral economics, human factors, or UX research.

- Experience at a consumer tech company at scale, especially one with user-generated content, creator platforms, or payments.

- Experience supporting security compliance programs (e.g. SOC 2), or being an early or founding hire in a trust, safety, or security function.

jobs.description:
Amazon Private Brands (APB) is reinventing Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) with AI at its core. Private Brands Central (PBC) is our PLM platform, and we're building a new generation of AI-native experiences, from Gen AI copilots that accelerate new product development to agentic workflows that automate the manual, high-dwell steps in bringing a product to market.

As a Software Development Engineer II on our team, you will design and build the AI-powered components and features that make this happen, working across the full software development lifecycle, from working backwards from customer needs through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. This is a hands-on role where you'll embed Gen AI and agentic capabilities into sourcing, quality, sustainability, and detail-page workflows, turn functional and technical requirements into clean, maintainable code, and collaborate closely with engineers and internal customers to deliver the right solutions. You'll get to apply the latest Gen AI tools and techniques to real, high-volume product-development problems and see the efficiency gains land. Your work will directly shape how APB products are sourced, developed, and launched.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement scalable components and features across the PBC PLM platform, translating functional and technical requirements into clean, well-structured code.
- Contribute across the full software development lifecycle — design, code review, testing, deployment, and operational support — identifying and resolving root causes of operational issues.
- Build customer-facing experiences and back-end services that support sourcing, quality, sustainability, and detail-page workflows.
- Collaborate with engineers, product partners, APB stakeholders, and the 3P PLM vendor to understand needs and deliver the right solutions.
- Evaluate and integrate new tools and approaches — including generative AI and automation capabilities — to improve productivity, code quality, and product-development workflows.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing a design document for a new PBC feature, then jump into a code review with a teammate before writing code for a capability that helps APB teams move faster. After lunch, you could pair with a colleague to troubleshoot an operational issue, find its root cause, and implement a permanent fix. Throughout, you'll balance new feature work with operational improvements, and regularly connect with the engineers and business partners who rely on the systems you build.

About the team
This team builds functional modules within the Private Brands Central Product Lifecycle Management tool to accelerate speed to market for new product development for Amazon Private Brands (APB) and reduce dwell time for specific processes, increasingly powered by Gen AI and automation. Examples include: developing an externalized module for sourcing Request For Quotations (RFQs) from APB suppliers, launching an automated process to manage sustainability and quality related claims for APB products, and automating ASIN and Detail Page creation on Amazon systems. The team is partnering with a 3P solution to build out an integrated PLM tool with an industry-leading software solution.
